# Working Notes — General Provisions (Secs. 529–541)

## Sec. 529 — Research/Evaluation/Statistical Funding Availability
- Applies to: (1) Administration for Children and Families (HHS); (2) Chief Evaluation Office and statistical-related cooperative/interagency agreements and contracting activities of the Bureau of Labor Statistics (DOL).
- Funds appropriated/allocated/advanced on reimbursable basis/transferred for research, evaluation, or statistical purposes → available for obligation **through September 30, 2028**.
- When such offices receive R&E funding from multiple appropriations, they may use a **single Treasury account**, with funding advanced on reimbursable basis.
- Unexpended amounts at completion of contract/grant/cooperative agreement may be deobligated; become immediately available; may be reobligated in that FY or subsequent FY for the same research/evaluation/statistical purposes.

## Sec. 530 — Critical Race Theory
- No funds may carry out any program/project/activity that promotes or advances Critical Race Theory or any associated concept.

## Sec. 531 — Prohibited Executive Orders (Racial Equity/DEIA)
- No funds to implement/administer/apply/enforce/carry out:
  - EO 13985 (Jan. 20, 2021; 86 Fed. Reg. 7009 — racial equity/underserved communities);
  - EO 14035 (June 25, 2021; 86 Fed. Reg. 34593 — DEIA in federal workforce);
  - EO 14091 (Feb. 16, 2023; 88 Fed. Reg. 10825 — further advancing racial equity).

## Sec. 532 — Foreign Adversary Laboratories
- No funds to support, directly/indirectly: Wuhan Institute of Virology, or any lab owned/controlled by governments of China, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Venezuela (Maduro regime), or any other country determined by Secretary of State to be a foreign adversary.

## Sec. 533 — Gain-of-Function Research
- No funds, directly/indirectly, to conduct/support gain-of-function research involving a potential pandemic pathogen by any country determined by Secretary of State to be a foreign adversary, including China, Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Venezuela (Maduro regime).

## Sec. 534 — Gender-Affirming Care
- No funds for surgical procedures or hormone therapies for purposes of gender affirming care.

## Sec. 535 — DEI Offices/Programs/Training
- No funds to implement/administer/apply/enforce/carry out any diversity, equity, and inclusion office, program, or training.

## Sec. 536 — Reproductive Healthcare Executive Orders
- No funds to implement/administer/enforce EO 14076 (Protecting Access to Reproductive Healthcare Services) or EO 14079 (Securing Access to Reproductive and Other Healthcare Services).

## Sec. 537 — Religious/Moral Belief re Marriage Protection
- Notwithstanding 1 U.S.C. §7, 28 U.S.C. §1738C, or any other law: no funds (this Act or prior appropriations Acts) may take discriminatory action against a person based on speech/action per sincerely held religious belief or moral conviction that marriage is/should be union of one man and one woman.
- "Discriminatory action" defined (subsec. b): altering federal tax treatment / assessing tax, penalty, payment / denying
